paired_seed_tests.description: Pair candidate and baseline by input, replica and seed. Each replica uses its seed for initial velocities and Langevin integrator. For each metric form candidate-minus-baseline differences across the eight seeds; repeated timings are not additional independent seeds. Reduce repeated observations within seed by median before seed-level inference. Fixed seeds give reproducibility but do not make Langevin outputs scientifically deterministic.

confidence_rule.decision: Use exact binomial order-statistic bounds. Performance: one-sided lower confidence bound on paired baseline_wall/method_wall ratios must exceed 1.05. Science: two-sided confidence intervals for median paired differences must lie strictly inside each [-abs_margin,+abs_margin]; allocate alpha/2 to each of the two metrics by Bonferroni, then split each metric alpha between its two tails. Non-significance is not equivalence. Require both science metrics and valid fixed work before performance success. Apply rule separately at each sealed budget and method; report all cells, no pooled or best-cell family claim.
confidence_rule.scope_limit: Statistical equivalence of these two energy summaries cannot establish full energy-series identity or same-seed run-to-run equivalence demanded by the brief. Those stronger claims remain unverified and must not be reported as passed; changing scientific scope or margins requires a new sealed run.

representative_scale.gpu_class: One NVIDIA H100, A100 or A10 class GPU, same physical GPU for baseline and candidate; actual model pending environment evidence.

configuration.difference_from_published_throughput_tes: Brief fixes work and seeds and requests deterministic forces; published benchmark.py runs a fixed-time throughput test. Published NVIDIA numbers are not fixed-work ensemble measurements.

outputs.full_energy_series_reason: Driver samples energies internally but writes only final and mean. Full-series comparison requires recording samples in a later implementation; no invented existing output.

timing_scope.ensemble: perf_counter starts after PDB loading, force-field/system creation and platform selection; includes all eight sequential context/integrator creations, initializations, kernel compilation, stepping, energy queries and context teardown; stops before JSON output and printing.
timing_scope.replica: Starts after context creation and positions/velocities initialization; includes steps and energy queries; stops before context/integrator destruction.
timing_scope.candidate: For comparable ensemble timing include candidate replica setup, stepping, sampling and teardown plus orchestration within ensemble wall interval; report any differing boundary.

science.required_work: Exactly eight replicas, seeds 1000–1007, 25000 steps each, 100 energy samples each, unchanged physical model.
science.full_series_requirement: Brief requests identical per-replica energy series; existing JSON cannot prove full-series identity.
science.reason: No published tolerance; no run-to-run variation measurements supplied.
